sarah: quick sync — onboarding for llama3-xx hitting a small but blocking tokenizer delta. when using our chat template + model's special tokens, token counts shift by 1 and EOS sometimes gets attached to the assistant turn. can we validate before promoting weights?
maya: can repro locally. difference looks like tokenizer config mismatch: model bundle has add_bos: true but our onboarding code assumes add_bos: false. simple repro:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('\\nUser: hi\\nAssistant: hey').ids)
```
ids include an extra leading token when add_bos is true.
liam: weights/manifest info — the bundle in gs is at gs://redwood-models/private/llama3-xx/2026-03-01/weights.tar.gz and manifest is gs://redwood-models/private/llama3-xx/2026-03-01/manifest.json. onboarding should check tokenizer.special_tokens and model_config.add_bos/append_eos parity. also note serving runtime default append_eos=true unless overridden in model config.
joel: opened a tiny PR to add an onboarding validation step (checks: special token ids exist, add_bos consistent, append_eos explicit). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboard/pull/412 — please review, I added unit tests that cover the off-by-one case.
sarah: thanks. i pushed a quick prompt set to the evals repo to catch this class of regression (short chat template + assistant with trailing punctuation). will add to onboarding checklist.
maya: small suggestion for sanitizing templates before token counting — strip implicit assistant prefix/eos when computing max_tokens. example snippet:
```py
def count_tokens(tokenizer, chat_parts):
    # chat_parts = [("user", "..."), ("assistant","...")]
    text = "\n".join(f"{role.capitalize()}: {msg.strip()}" for role,msg in chat_parts)
    # if tokenizer adds BOS, remove it from count baseline
    ids = tokenizer.encode(text).ids
    if tokenizer.config.get('add_bos'):
        ids = ids[1:]
    # if model config append_eos is true we'll reserve 1 token
    return len(ids)
```
liam: nice. i'll wire the manifest check into the onboarding pipeline so missing fields cause a hard fail. also will add a quick compatibility warning in the console: "tokenizer.add_bos != assumed_add_bos".
sarah: can someone run a dedicated staging smoke after the PR merges? just need a sanity check for: encoding parity, sample generate with max_new_tokens, and streaming boundaries.
